ideas.pitch: A mobile WebAR application that allows medical students to visualize complex 3D organ layers and surgical procedures on any flat surface without needing expensive VR headsets.
ideas.problem_statement: Transforming education and healthcare using immersive technologies under the Reality, Reimagined theme.
ideas.title: AnatomyAR: Interactive Surgical Training in WebAR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in AR/VR hackathons heavily favor functional real-world utility over flashy games, and healthcare visualization offers immediate, measurable educational value that is easy to demo live on a phone.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight VR walkthrough experience built in Unity that reconstructs destroyed historical monuments using photogrammetry assets and allows multi-user exploration.
ideas.problem_statement: Transforming tourism and education using immersive technologies under the Reality, Reimagined theme.
ideas.title: HeritageVR: Reconstructing Lost Architecture
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leveraging proven Unity 3D environmental design patterns allows for rapid prototyping of high-aesthetic environments that score exceptionally well on visual polish and user experience.

ideas.pitch: An XR rehabilitation assistant that uses webcam computer vision to track skeletal joints in real time and projects correct form overlays for physical therapy patients.
ideas.problem_statement: Transforming healthcare and industry through computer vision and immersive applications under the Reality, Reimagined theme.
ideas.title: PoseFit XR: Computer Vision Physical Therapy Guide
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard computer vision engineering with practical healthcare applications, directly matching the technical skills emphasized in Round 1's assessment criteria.

ideas.pitch: A desktop VR training simulation for factory workers to identify and mitigate safety hazards in a simulated industrial plant environment.
ideas.problem_statement: Transforming industry and safety training using immersive technologies under the Reality, Reimagined theme.
ideas.title: SafeSite XR: Industrial Hazard Simulation
ideas.why_it_could_win: B2B enterprise use cases appeal strongly to judges looking for scalable real-world economic impact rather than pure consumer entertainment.

ideas.pitch: An augmented reality mobile tool that overlays local air quality data, solar panel efficiency potentials, and urban green spaces onto the user's live camera feed.
ideas.problem_statement: Solving real-world problems and creating meaningful impact through augmented reality under the Reality, Reimagined theme.
ideas.title: EcoLens: AR Environmental Impact Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a pressing real-world environmental issue with a highly intuitive user experience that makes abstract data instantly tangible through spatial computing.
